_comment: Vermont draft QAP dated 2026-06-23 (VHFA). Section 4 Evaluation Criteria applies to Ceiling Credits (9%) only. Source PDF had an unmappable Type3 font and was OCR-ed with --force-ocr, so quotes are matched against the OCR text layer.

qap_updates.notes: DRAFT dated June 23 2026; the title page effective date is still a placeholder, so these values are provisional. Source PDF used an embedded Type3 font with no Unicode mapping (3% letter ratio); OCR-ed with ocrmypdf --force-ocr to 80% letters. Vermont replaced its checkmark system with points in this cycle - the signed 2024-25 QAP scored applications in checkmarks. No maximum total score is stated. Section 4 applies to Ceiling Credits only; Bond Credit (4%) applications are explicitly excluded from it.

groups.label: Site Location and Designations (4.01 a or b)
groups.note: Two mutually exclusive designation tiers: 15 points for Downtown / Village Center / New Town Center / Act 181 Center, 10 points for Growth Center / Neighborhood Development Area / adjacency / Act 181 Neighborhood / Opportunity Zone. Group contributes max(15, 10) = 15.

criteria.quote: A deduction of 10 points will be applied for sites with negative features
criteria.note: Deduction, not an award. Excluded from the positive total; points_max holds the magnitude. Waived if the negative feature is effectively addressed.
